doc_friction.issue: Says run_workflow_locally --for-changes runs what the diff triggers, but it detaches after ~100 s and any tracked edit while it runs voids the rest; a first-run orphan fix therefore forces a second full run. A note to fix sibling links before the first run (or to run siblings.mjs --check first for a new venture) would save a cycle.

Says to add a row and the build.mjs slug when a tool lands, but not the other registrations a new venture needs (launched.json, optout-switches.txt, a sibling link from an existing page); found by copying the kriging PR's file list.

A local ventures-tests run left `git config user.email ci@example.com` in the repository, so the next commit was Unverified until amended; the runner (or the test that sets it) should restore git config.

deviations.why: The normalisation by sqrt(points below the line + 1) I first used gave false-alarm rates rising with n (2.4/5.5/8.2% at n=30/60/200) in simulation, and the paper was not available to check its exact form.
deviations.did: Normalised by sqrt(points off the line + 1) and documented it as conservative, with eval/cusum-normalisation.mjs reproducing both.
deviations.result: At most 0.1% false alarms at nominal 5%, 87.8% power on a moderate quadratic; documented on the page, README and PAPERS.

notes: Explore idea: method comparison as a research-algorithm tool (ventures/method-comparison); no venture README mentioned Deming regression, Passing-Bablok or method comparison. Passing-Bablok with rank CIs and CUSUM; above 600 pairs order statistics by merge-sort inversion counting of y - t x plus bisection (8,850,570 slopes on NHANES, ~1-2 s in Chromium); Deming/weighted Deming with O(n) jackknife; Bland-Altman with CIs and percent scale; decision-level bias (Deming jackknife, PB bootstrap <=500 pairs); Kendall tau-b by Knight. Real data: NHANES 2017-2018 BP methodology study (mercury vs Omron HEM-907XL), 4,212 adults: cuff 1.31 mmHg lower (CI 1.01-1.61), LoA -20.87 to 18.25, OLS slope 0.872 vs PB 1.0232 / Deming 1.0172. Verification: independent numpy/scipy reference (eval/make_reference.py) on 33 sets + NHANES (Deming closed form 1e-10, ODR 1e-5, jackknife 1e-9, PB exact-fraction listing 1e-12 with N/K exact, Kendall vs scipy); fast vs brute PB on 400 tie-heavy sets; Bland & Altman 1986 PEFR reproduces -2.1/38.8/-79.7..75.5; 1,000-set simulation coverage Deming 95.5%, PB 95.4%, weighted Deming 96.7%. methcomp 1.0.0 read and not used (Deming uses np.cov(x,y)[1][1]). All 9 DOIs checked on Crossref. Chromium at 1200/390 px: no console errors, no external requests, no overflow. Local CI: run_workflow_locally --for-changes: control-plane-guard, checklist-coverage, conflict-markers, doc-refs, duplicate-symbols, link-contrast, readme-live-links, page-integrity, agent-permission-harness, pages 6/6 passed; sibling-links failed (orphan) then 2/2 after the inter-rater-agreement link; ventures-tests failed once (csv formula guard flagged csvCell shape) then 5/5 after the fix; portfolio-validate 100/100, portfolio-pages 12/12. uses: and secret-reading steps not run locally. No agent doc in docs/reports: the README Verification and the post carry what the next run needs. Next: repeated-measures Bland-Altman, regression-based LoA, lambda from duplicates.
